chunks: Ismāʿīl ibn Muslim narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, from his forefathers عليهم السلام:

That the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was approached by a man, who said: “O Messenger of Allah, to you I complain of what I suffer from whisperings in my salat (prayer), until I no longer understand what I have prayed, whether there was addition or نقصān (omission).”

So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said to him: “When you enter into your salat (prayer), then strike your left thigh with your right index finger, then say: ‘In the Name of Allah, and by Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah. I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the accursed Shayṭān.’”
“For indeed you strike him, rebuke him, and drive him away from yourself.”

key_terms.الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ: the accursed Devil, from whom refuge is sought
key_terms.الْوَسْوَسَةِ: satanic whisperings or intrusive doubts affecting concentration in worship
key_terms.تَوَكَّلْتُ: I placed my trust and reliance upon Allah
key_terms.زِيَادَةٍ: an addition in the prayer beyond what is prescribed
key_terms.صَلَاتِي: my salat (prayer), the ritual prayer in which the person experiences confusion
key_terms.نُقْصَانٍ: an omission or deficiency in the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do when whisperings cause confusion in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a prophetic practice for one afflicted by waswasah during salat (prayer), especially when confusion leads to uncertainty about addition or omission. It combines a physical gesture with seeking refuge in Allah, emphasizing reliance upon Him and repelling Shayṭān during worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.983 - Ismail ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his forefathers (as) that:
"The Messenger of Allah (sw) was approached by a man who said:
'O’ Messenger of Allah (sw), I complain to you about the whispers (waswasah) I experience during my prayers, to the point that I no longer comprehend what I have prayed, whether I have added something or omitted something.'
The Messenger of Allah (sw) responded: 'When you enter into your prayer, strike your left thigh with your right index finger, then say: "In the name of Allah (swt), and with Allah (swt), I place my trust in Allah (swt). I seek refuge with Allah (swt), the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the accursed Devil."
By doing this, you will strike him and ward him off, and he will be driven away from you.'".
